items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event overlapping so both run before the id is inserted, causing double handling.
Gap 1 says the dedup key comes from X-Event-Id and that the header is an unsigned copy rather than the signed body id.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, so refunds are never handled.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrency within the one queue.
